objective: Prepare a strictly offline and privacy-safe file-import adapter for FX and crypto market quotes that may later be supplied from legally entitled research data; synthetic fixtures for CI and no real provider/API certification.
scope: New standalone license-state-quarantined CSV import layer with no network/credentials and no trading authority
Read sanitized market reference files only from explicit fixed minimal allowlist and cap size/records
Time, bid/ask, pair/unit, provider-origin, source-mode and data-provenance checks with deterministic hashes
Preserve origin/rights as UNVERIFIED and prevent imported user data feeding signals until evidence and license approval
Generate JSON and static Persian HTML provenance/quality reports from fully synthetic CI fixtures, deterministic double replay
Independent A5/A8/A10 review and owner Human Gate if required before merge; keep P24 gates unchanged
out_of_scope: Real Dukascopy, Binance, TradingView, CoinGecko, Kraken, MT5 or exchange API calls, any geo/IP restriction bypass
Production provider/venue selection, account creation, OAuth, keys, credentials, trading and real price entitlement claims
Bypassing P07 source quality or trading policy, changing risk ceilings/Owner Gate or LIVE/AUTO
Modifying other PRs #492/493/494/499 or WEB-P0 files
dependencies: P24-A canonical and all PRE_FIRST_LIVE P24-B blockers unchanged
Reference only: ADR-0002, P05 instrument contracts, P07 trusted data, P24 WQ parallel mock work
Previous solo-owner governance RFC #500 merged, but any explicit independent review requirement remains binding
tests: At least 25 deterministic input-safety and source-provenance tests
Reject account secrets/unknown schema, LIVE/prod claims, untrusted sources and CSV escape tricks
Decimal finite quote, bid/ask, symbol identity, time monotonicity, stale/future and data capacity tests
Hash canonical input/normalized evidence; replay twice with identical bytes
Full strict Pyright and GitHub Governance at final head

CSV import is never a legal license attestation
Research signal authority always false; no real money or broker access
Do not leak arbitrary CSV content into logs or HTML
evidence: Guarded source provenance plus immutable SHA256
GitHub CI latest head with tests and hashes
Independent A5/A8/A10 reviewer decision, if required
Linear + GitHub #491 comment and postmerge reconciliation
rollback: Revert new WS files only; no external states changed
definition_of_ready: Main SHA identified and no overlapping paths with pending P24/WEB PRs
All external data rights considered unverified; only synthetic CI fixtures
definition_of_done: Full test, Pyright, Governance and double replay PASS
Independent A5/A8/A10 review recorded according to task requirements
